limitations: Audits source provenance, finite saved diagnostics, complete accepted histories and internal numerical consistency; no independent trajectory/kernel rerun.
The exact scalar entropy guard is recomputed from saved identity error, residual contraction and defect budget; this is not independent PDE residual evaluation from full state vectors.
Finest adjacent time-pair status is distinct from coarsest-to-finest and every intervening pair; no fine-pair certification of the baseline.
Grid-array bytes, workspace index count and cumulative process high-water RSS are separate measurements; timings retain each producing hardware/load record.
Only frozen-source fixed-reference artifacts are eligible; old-population and historical discrete-gradient evidence are excluded.
Fixed-reference native and represented-state residuals are acceptance diagnostics; the old-population norm is only a finite nonnegative diagnostic with no acceptance threshold.
Saved endpoint invariants, full mu populations and entropy are independently checked using NumPy quadrature and analytic field formulas; the full pair residual is not independently recomputed here.
